title.en: The energy pyramid and trophic levels

description.zh: 生产者固定阳光、逐级约一成传递、顶级捕食者所需面积、三种金字塔与饮食的土地账；示例量级的教学模型。
description.en: Producers fixing sunlight, roughly ten percent passing up each level, the area top predators need, three kinds of pyramid and the land ledger of diets; a teaching model with example magnitudes.

label.zh: 能量只会被消耗，不会凭空增加

reason.zh: 每传一级一部分变成热散失，能量金字塔上小下大是能量守恒与耗散的结果。
reason.en: A share is lost as heat at each step, so the energy pyramid narrows upward as a result of conservation with dissipation.

label.zh: 低一级的供给限制高一级的数量

reason.zh: 下一级提供的能量决定上一级能养活多少个体，是一种由资源供给形成的限制。
reason.en: The energy a level supplies caps how many individuals the level above can sustain, a resource-supply constraint.

label.en: Annual production is an accumulated rate

reason.zh: 每年产量 = 生物量 × 更替率，说明某一时刻的存量与单位时间的流量是两个不同的量。
reason.en: Annual production = biomass × turnover, showing that a stock at one moment and a flow per unit time are different quantities.

title.zh: 为什么顶级捕食者那么少？
title.en: Why are top predators so rare?
